entities.name: Maurice-Marie-Matthieu Garrigou

entities.summary: Maurice-Marie-Matthieu Garrigou was a French Roman Catholic priest who established the Sisters of Our Lady of Compassion. He served in the priesthood during the tumultuous French Revolution.
